title: State Commission Functioning at State Capital and Other Notified Places

content.scenario: The State Government of Maharashtra notifies Pune as a place where the State Commission can function, in addition to the state capital Mumbai. A consumer in Pune files a complaint against a company.
content.outcome: The State Commission can function at Pune and hear the complaint, as it is a notified place, in addition to the state capital Mumbai, as per Section 42(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: Where can the State Commission function?
Can the State Commission hear complaints at places other than the state capital?
What are the conditions for the State Commission to function at other places?
